property_summary: supportsInterface must be monotone under the ERC-165 composition chain: any interfaceId reported supported by the base ERC165Upgradeable (i.e., the IERC165 id 0x01ffc9a7) must also be reported supported by C, but the bugged override returns false for 0x01ffc9a7.
change_summary: Change the supportsInterface implementation to only check the IAccessControl interface ID, dropping the superclass ERC165 check for IERC165.
